_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: After Action Report
summary: The After Action Report (AAR) provides information after each mission event to help the government capitalize on successes, identify areas for improvement, and improve the quality of support in meeting the Fleet's Training Objectives.
use_relationship:
The After Action Report (AAR) provides information after each mission event. This will provide the government the capability to capitalize on successes, identify areas for improvement and take appropriate action to improve the overall quality of support in meeting the Fleet's Training Objectives through effective application of range systems, assets, and capabilities.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains content, preparation instructions and intended use information for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Provide breakdown of support elements with an evaluation of the effectiveness and performance rating for each element
Provide results of the initial post impressions and event analysis
Provide technical and operational assessment that describes areas of success and areas for improvement
Provide root cause analysis results for all support issues or failures in operations and mission support
